note: A server's tool is approved and granted 'always', then its definition changes (Invariant Labs rug pull). The change must be quarantined before the tool is offered or run in a new segment, the old grant must stop covering it, and re-approval must drop the stale grant (R11 9.7: pin sha256 of name/description/schemas/annotations, diff on EVERY tools/list). 'notify' cases send notifications/tools/list_changed; silent ones do not, so detection relies on the per-list diff when the catalog is next re-listed (after maxCatalogAge, the app's 1 minute).
